summary.goal: Create persistent messaging sidebar with channel list, message stream, and input
summary.context: Replaces the modal ChatPanel with a persistent right sidebar. Similar to Slack or relay-dashboard messaging UX. Collapsible, shows channels, active channel messages, input with @mentions.

acceptance_criteria.description: Sidebar is fixed-width right panel (420px), not modal
Can be collapsed to icon strip (~48px wide)
Channel list at top with unread indicators
Message stream scrollable with auto-scroll on new messages
Message input at bottom with @mention support
Presence shown in channel header

design_spec.notes: Adapts relay-dashboard messaging patterns to planner-ui Tailwind setup. Uses CSS variables from globals.css (bg-bg-*, text-text-*, accent-*, border-*). All components use Tailwind utility classes.
reuse_from_planner_ui: ChatPanel.tsx - panel structure (fixed right-0, w-[420px], flex-col), header pattern, input form layout
ChatMessage.tsx - message bubble structure, typing indicator animation
icons/ - ChevronLeft, Hash, MessageIcon, CloseIcon patterns
copy_from_relay_dashboard: ChannelSidebar.tsx - channel list structure, section headers ('Channels', 'Direct Messages'), unread badge styling
ChannelChat.tsx - message bubble positioning (isOwn ? flex-end : flex-start), timestamp formatting

key_tailwind_classes.sidebar_expanded: fixed right-0 top-0 h-full w-[420px] bg-bg-secondary border-l border-border-subtle flex flex-col z-40
key_tailwind_classes.sidebar_collapsed: fixed right-0 top-0 h-full w-12 bg-bg-secondary border-l border-border-subtle flex flex-col items-center py-4 z-40
key_tailwind_classes.channel_item: px-4 py-2 flex items-center gap-2 hover:bg-bg-hover cursor-pointer
key_tailwind_classes.unread_badge: bg-accent-cyan text-bg-deep text-xs font-semibold rounded-full px-2 min-w-[18px] text-center
key_tailwind_classes.message_user: bg-accent-cyan/10 border border-accent-cyan/20 rounded-lg ml-12 mr-2 p-3
key_tailwind_classes.message_agent: bg-bg-tertiary border border-border-subtle rounded-lg ml-2 mr-12 p-3
key_tailwind_classes.agent_avatar: w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-accent-purple flex items-center justify-center text-bg-deep text-sm font-medium
key_tailwind_classes.input_area: bg-bg-tertiary border border-border-subtle rounded-lg focus:border-accent-cyan focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-cyan/50
key_tailwind_classes.send_button: bg-accent-cyan text-bg-deep font-medium rounded-lg px-4 py-2 hover:shadow-glow-cyan transition-all

key_tailwind_classes.section_header: text-xs text-text-muted uppercase tracking-wide px-4 py-2 font-semibold

component_structure.MessagingSidebar: Root container. Props: isExpanded, onToggle. Renders ChannelList, ChannelHeader, MessageStream, MessageInput based on state.
component_structure.ChannelList: Two sections: 'Global' (#planner) and 'Plan Channels' (#plan-*). Maps channels array to ChannelItem buttons.
component_structure.ChannelHeader: Shows #channel-name, presence count ('3 online'), avatar stack (max 5 avatars, +N overflow).
component_structure.MessageStream: Scrollable div with messages array. Uses ref for auto-scroll. Handles scroll-to-load-more on scroll top.
component_structure.MessageInput: Textarea + send button. @mention triggers popup. Disabled when disconnected.

state_management.RelayProvider: App-level context providing single shared WebSocket connection. Wraps entire app in main.tsx. Manages connection lifecycle, reconnection, and user identity.
state_management.useRelay: Hook to access shared connection from RelayProvider. Returns { connection, isConnected, userId, displayName }. Components use this instead of useRelayConnection directly.
state_management.useRelayConnection: (internal) Low-level hook used only by RelayProvider. Not called directly by components.
state_management.useChannels: Fetches channel list, tracks activeChannel, unreadCounts. Receives connection from useRelay().
state_management.useChannelMessages: Loads history via REST, appends from WebSocket. Receives connection from useRelay().
state_management.usePresence: Fetches presence via REST, updates from WebSocket join/leave events. Receives connection from useRelay().

steps.title: Create useRelayConnection hook
steps.description: Hook that manages WebSocket connection to /ws/relay. Handles connect, reconnect, disconnect. Exposes connection status and send/receive methods.

acceptance_criteria.description: useRelayConnection() returns { status, connect, disconnect, send, onMessage }
Auto-reconnects on disconnect with backoff
Status: 'connecting' | 'connected' | 'disconnected' | 'error'

steps.title: Create useChannels hook
steps.description: Hook for channel operations. Fetches channel list, manages active channel, handles channel switching. Integrates with useRelayConnection for real-time updates.

acceptance_criteria.description: useChannels() returns { channels, activeChannel, setActiveChannel, unreadCounts }
Channels fetched from GET /api/channels
Unread counts update on new messages
Channel list updates when new channels created

steps.title: Create useChannelMessages hook
steps.description: Hook for messages in active channel. Loads history, appends new messages from WebSocket, handles pagination.

acceptance_criteria.description: useChannelMessages(channelId) returns { messages, sendMessage, loadMore, hasMore }
History loaded from GET /api/channels/:id/messages
New messages appended from WebSocket
Pagination loads older messages on scroll up

steps.title: Create usePresence hook
steps.description: Hook for presence in active channel. Shows who (agents, users) is online. Updates in real-time.

acceptance_criteria.description: usePresence(channelId) returns { members, onlineCount }
Presence loaded from GET /api/channels/:id/presence
Real-time updates on join/leave via WebSocket

steps.title: Create ChannelList component
steps.description: Collapsible list of channels. Shows #planner and #plan-{id} channels. Highlights active channel. Shows unread badges.

acceptance_criteria.description: Renders list of channels
Active channel highlighted
Unread count badge shown per channel
Click switches active channel
Collapsible sections: Global (#planner), Plan channels

steps.title: Create ChannelHeader component
steps.description: Header for active channel. Shows channel name, presence count, and online member avatars (agents have distinct style).

acceptance_criteria.description: Shows channel name (e.g., #plan-abc123)
Shows presence count (e.g., '3 online')
Shows avatar stack for online members
Agents have distinct avatar style (icon vs initials)

steps.title: Create MessageStream component
steps.description: Scrollable list of messages. Different styles for user vs agent messages. Markdown rendering for agent responses. Auto-scroll to bottom on new messages.

acceptance_criteria.description: Renders message list from useChannelMessages
User messages right-aligned, agent messages left-aligned
Agent messages show agent name and avatar
Markdown rendered in message content
Auto-scrolls to bottom when new message arrives
Loads more messages on scroll to top

steps.title: Create MessageInput component
steps.description: Input for composing messages. Supports @mentions with autocomplete popup. Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline.

acceptance_criteria.description: Textarea input with send button
@mention triggers autocomplete popup
Autocomplete shows agents from presence
Selecting mention inserts @AgentName
Enter sends message, Shift+Enter for newline
Input disabled when disconnected

steps.title: Create MessagingSidebar component
steps.description: Main sidebar component composing ChannelList, ChannelHeader, MessageStream, and MessageInput. Supports collapsed/expanded state.

acceptance_criteria.description: Fixed width 420px in expanded state
Collapsed state shows icon strip ~48px
Toggle button to expand/collapse
Composes ChannelList, ChannelHeader, MessageStream, MessageInput
Connection status indicator in footer

steps.title: Integrate MessagingSidebar into Layout
steps.description: Add MessagingSidebar to app Layout. Replaces ChatPanel modal. Main content area adjusts width when sidebar expanded/collapsed.

acceptance_criteria.description: MessagingSidebar rendered in Layout
Main content shifts left when sidebar expanded
ChatPanel modal removed from codebase
Cmd+/ keyboard shortcut toggles sidebar

steps.title: Pass plan context to messages
steps.description: When in plan editor, include current plan ID and selected step in message context. PlannerLead uses this context for relevant responses.

acceptance_criteria.description: Messages include planId when in plan editor
Messages include selectedStepId when step selected
Context displayed in input area (e.g., 'Discussing: Step 3')

steps.title: Add demo mode fallback
steps.description: When relay unavailable, show demo channel with mock messages. Indicate demo mode clearly. Still allows exploring UI.

acceptance_criteria.description: Demo mode shown when connection fails
#demo channel with simulated messages
Clear 'Demo Mode' indicator in sidebar
Messages to demo channel get mock AI responses

steps.title: Create RelayProvider context
steps.description: Create a React context that provides a single shared WebSocket connection for the entire app. Wrap App in main.tsx. The provider manages connection lifecycle and exposes connection state to all descendants via useRelay() hook.

acceptance_criteria.description: RelayProvider context created in src/contexts/RelayContext.tsx
useRelay() returns { connection: UseRelayConnectionResult, isConnected, userId, displayName, isMock }
App wrapped with RelayProvider in main.tsx
Only ONE WebSocket connection created per browser session

steps.title: Integrate user identity with RelayProvider
steps.description: Use useCurrentUser() to get user identity. Generate stable userId (from useCurrentUser or sessionStorage fallback). Update useRelayConnection to accept optional userId param. Pass userId to ws-proxy via query param: /ws/relay?name=DisplayName&userId=user-id

acceptance_criteria.description: useRelayConnection accepts optional userId param
RelayProvider passes useCurrentUser().user_id or sessionStorage fallback
WebSocket URL includes userId: /ws/relay?name=X&userId=Y
Relay logs show stable user ID (e.g., dev-user-001) not random user-*

steps.title: Refactor consumers to use RelayProvider context
steps.description: Update MessagingSidebar and useAgentOrchestration to use useRelay() instead of calling useRelayConnection directly. Remove direct useRelayConnection imports from components.

acceptance_criteria.description: MessagingSidebar uses useRelay() instead of useRelayConnection
useAgentOrchestration uses useRelay() instead of useRelayConnection
No component directly calls useRelayConnection (only RelayProvider does)
Browser shows single WebSocket connection in DevTools Network tab
Relay logs show stable user identity across page navigation
